title: Fix GeoShapeGeoGridTestCase#testGeoShapeBounds after adding support for geohex aggregation on geoshape

timeline.message: Fix GeoShapeGeoGridTestCase#testGeoShapeBounds after adding support for geohex aggregation on geoshape
timeline.author: iverase

timeline.body:
This PR updates the test to take into account that for the new aggregation it is possible that a point resolves in more than one bucket.

fixes #92563
I think it makes sense to have this method as public.

timeline.author: iverase
